title: FAIRPIVARA: REDUCING AND ASSESSING BIASES IN CLIP-BASED MULTIMODAL MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the cosine similarity distance between image embeddings of individuals with different disability statuses (Mental, Physical, Non-Disabled) and text embeddings of positive and negative concepts.
Calculating the cosine similarity distance between image embeddings of various nationalities (American, Arab, Chinese, Mexican) and text embeddings of positive and negative concepts.

Calculating the cosine similarity distance between image embeddings representing different religious groups (Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim) and text embeddings of positive and negative concepts.
Calculating the cosine similarity distance between image embeddings representing different sexual orientations (Heterosexual, LGBT) and text embeddings of positive and negative concepts.
